_about: List prices in US dollars per million tokens, used for the cost axis. One snapshot per date: never edit a past snapshot, add a new one. Cost = input tokens x input price + output tokens (thinking included) x output price. Cached-input discounts are not applied: every benchmark picture is new to a real user, and repeated runs of the same picture would otherwise look cheaper than a first call.

2026-10-08.source: OpenRouter model catalogue (https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models), read 2026-10-08; for first-party models it lists the maker's own API price. DeepSeek checked on https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing the same day.

deepseek-flash.note: DeepSeek's peak-hours price; off-peak (outside 01-04 and 06-10 UTC on weekdays) is half. We use the peak price for every call so the time of day does not change the chart
